div.div: Every state except DL_INIT, DL_HS_RX and DL_HS_EOT goes to DL_STOP on LP-11; only the regular LP-11 exits are drawn. Escape watchdog expiry (No.6) in DL_LP_RQST to DL_ESC_CMD: DL_ESC_WAIT, no PPI error. dl_enable_x Low holds the lane in DL_INIT; a rising forcerxmode_x returns it there. The fall of the sync-search start, on leaving DL_HS_RX, is the EoT request to No.4. Outputs not written beside a state keep their inactive value.
